indicators.label: Mars-Saturn conjunction
indicators.definition: sidereal angular separation of Mars and Saturn <= 8 degrees

indicators.label: Mars-Ketu conjunction
indicators.definition: separation of Mars and Ketu (mean node) <= 8 degrees

indicators.label: Eclipse within 7 days
indicators.definition: within 7 days either side of a solar or lunar eclipse maximum

indicators.label: Sun sign ingress (sankranti) within 2 days
indicators.definition: within 2 days either side of the Sun entering a sidereal sign

indicators.label: Mars station within 3 days
indicators.definition: within 3 days of a Mars station

indicators.label: Mercury station within 3 days
indicators.definition: within 3 days of a Mercury station

indicators.label: Venus station within 3 days
indicators.definition: within 3 days of a Venus station

indicators.label: Jupiter station within 3 days
indicators.definition: within 3 days of a Jupiter station

indicators.label: Saturn station within 3 days
indicators.definition: within 3 days of a Saturn station

indicators.label: Moon in a Vayu-mandala nakshatra
indicators.definition: Moon in one of: Ashvini, Mrigashira, Punarvasu, Uttara Phalguni, Hasta, Chitra, Swati

indicators.label: Moon in an Agni-mandala nakshatra
indicators.definition: Moon in one of: Bharani, Krittika, Pushya, Magha, Purva Phalguni, Vishakha, Purva Bhadrapada

indicators.label: Moon in an Indra-mandala nakshatra
indicators.definition: Moon in one of: Rohini, Anuradha, Jyeshtha, Uttara Ashadha, Shravana, Dhanishtha

indicators.label: Moon in a Varuna-mandala nakshatra
indicators.definition: Moon in one of: Ardra, Ashlesha, Mula, Purva Ashadha, Shatabhisha, Uttara Bhadrapada, Revati

note: Moon-mandala windows change about daily and are not exported as intervals; each event carries its state.
